notes:
## What's New in 0.1.1

### Audio & Voice
- Improved SDL2 audio buffering and underrun recovery to eliminate crackling/stuttering (`soundinfo` reports SDL callback frames and underruns).
- Added optional background mute when unfocused / Alt-Tab (`snd_mute_losefocus`, enabled by default, toggleable in **Options -> Audio**).

### Window & Alt-Tab
- Fullscreen mode now properly minimizes on Alt-Tab instead of remaining behind other windows.

### HUD, Menus & Console
- Fixed AMXX menus closing when switching to Spectator.
- Moved HUD Layout Editor toolbar below `Spectator Banner` and made it draggable by its title bar.
- Console now keeps your scroll position when scrolled up during active chat/logging, and resumes auto-scroll when scrolled to the bottom or submitting a command.

### Performance
- Reduced dynamic HUD rendering cost and optimized high-FPS frame pacing overhead.
